ModMetaData.name: Recoverable Throwables 1.5 v1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: Physical thrown weapons such as javelins, throwing axes and throwing knives become finite, recoverable equipment. V1.5 keeps the runtime-resolved Projectile.Launch hook from v1.4, makes the eligible weapon definition authoritative even if ballistics patches substitute the runtime projectile, tightens throwable-name detection to avoid false positives such as Gun_Slugthrower, and removes the broken Grenade One-Use cross-patch. Explosive grenade-style throwables remain the responsibility of Grenade One-Use v1.1.
